3. Description of Incident

At approximately 8:30 AM, while descending the interior stairwell on the job site, Elba Vasquez's foot caught on a loose piece of banding/strap material left on the stairs, causing her to trip and fall, landing on her buttocks. The Safety Officer was notified and responded to the scene to assess the employee, document the incident, and photograph the tripping hazard.

4. Medical Response & Follow-Up
Occucare Evaluation Offered
The employee was offered transport to Occucare for a medical evaluation following the fall.
Employee Response
Elba Vasquez did not agree to go to Occucare today. She will go home to rest and will assess tomorrow whether she is able to return to work or needs to visit a clinic.
Action Taken
The employee's request was granted; she left the job site to go home and rest for the remainder of the day. She will follow up regarding her ability to return to work tomorrow or the need for a clinic visit. No further medical treatment was administered on site.
